message.content:
Los Angeles enjoys mild winter weather even in December. According to long‑term climatology (NOAA’s National Centers for Environmental Information), the **average** conditions for the city during this month are roughly:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Average daytime high | ~21–23 °C (70–73 °F) |
| Average nighttime low | ~12–14 °C (54–57 °F) |
| Mean monthly temperature | ≈16–18 °C (61–64 °F) |

These figures come from the “Monthly Climate Summary” for LAX (Los Angeles International Airport). In practice you’ll see highs ranging from the mid‑60s up into the upper 70s Fahrenheit on sunny days, while lows rarely dip below the lower 50s unless there’s a cold front. Snow is virtually nonexistent at sea level; occasional fog can keep mornings cooler than the averages suggest.
